intro.title: Service Overview
intro.body: iGM CLI is a command-line download tool built jointly by iGCraftLit × MuoCeon. It lets you search, download, update, and uninstall resources from iGCraftLit Community directly in CMD, PowerShell, or Bash, with first-class support for Minecraft mods, resource packs, maps, and modpacks. Every command uses the igm prefix.

features.title: Features
items: Search, download, and install with a single command.
Filter by game version and loader, including Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, and Quilt.
The igm.json config file supports batch installation and team collaboration.
Resumable downloads, local cache, and hash verification.
Integrated with the iGCraftLit account system, with login and synced download history.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
items: Public resources can be downloaded without signing in.
For private or login-required resources, run igm login first.
Access is fully open during the early stage and will be tightened gradually based on usage patterns.
Users must comply with the iGCraftLit Community User Rules.

install.title: Installation
install.lead: We recommend installing with npm or bun. You can also run the single file directly via「Generic Download」. Remote install scripts and the npx channel are coming soon.
install.done: Once installed, type igm in your terminal to get started.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.hint: Below is an overview of frequently asked questions. See the FAQ page for full answers.
faq.q1: Why is my request being rate limited?
faq.a1: To keep the service stable, the API enforces rate limits per IP address and per account. Very frequent requests are throttled temporarily; please wait and retry. Signing in grants a higher quota. If the problem persists, run igm doctor to check your network and backend connectivity.
faq.a2: When signed in, search and download history is synced with your account so you can view it across devices. When signed out, only the local cache is kept, which you can clear at any time with igm cache clean. We never collect terminal session content without authorization.
faq.a3: The iGM CLI tool itself is free and may be used for resource management in commercial environments. Resources downloaded through the tool remain subject to their own open-source licenses and author terms. Verify each resource's license before commercial use and follow the iGCraftLit Community User Rules.
faq.q4: How do I report an issue?
faq.a4: Email the team at igcraftlit@outlook.com (.NET) or igcraftlit@163.com (.CN), or submit feedback at https://igcraftlit.com. Putting "iGM CLI" in the subject line helps us locate the issue faster.
